chunks: And al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
"Zihar does not take effect in place of divorce, nor does divorce take effect in place of zihar."

key_terms.اَلصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام
key_terms.ظِهَارٌ: a pre-Islamic form of declaring one’s wife unlawful by likening her to a forbidden female relative
key_terms.يَقَعُ: takes legal effect or is established

ai.seo_question: Does zihar count as divorce, or can divorce count as zihar in Islamic law?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states a legal distinction between ẓihār and ṭalāq. Each has its own ruling and legal effect, and one does not substitute for the other in Islamic jurisprudence.
